newsitem.title: USA: Basin Electric Wyo. coal unit to return Friday.
newsitem.headline: Basin Electric Wyo. coal unit to return Friday.

text.p: Basin Electric Power Cooperative's 550 megawatt coal-fired Laramie River Station (LRS) unit 3 was expected to resume operation Friday afternoon after being shut early Wednesday for a boiler tube leak, a company spokesman said.
"We're hoping that unit will be up later this afternoon," spokesman Stan Stelter said Friday.

The unit, located in Wheatland, Wyoming, recently resumed full operation after being shut the week of August 7 for another boiler tube leak. Basin is the operator of the LRS station and majority owner with a 42.27 percent stake.
